name: anygamepad-web
description: Gamepad tester built on the anygamepad library compiled to WebAssembly.

scripts.wasm: npm run wasm:tester && npm run wasm:testing
scripts.wasm:tester: wasm-pack build ../../crates/anygamepad-wasm --release --target web --no-pack --out-dir ../../apps/web/src/wasm && wasm-opt -Oz src/wasm/anygamepad_wasm_bg.wasm -o src/wasm/anygamepad_wasm_bg.wasm
scripts.wasm:dev: wasm-pack build ../../crates/anygamepad-wasm --dev --target web --no-pack --out-dir ../../apps/web/src/wasm && wasm-pack build ../../crates/anygamepad-wasm-testing --dev --target web --no-pack --out-dir ../../apps/web/src/wasm-testing
